text:
maya: FYI ran the heron-xt-int4 onboarding canary overnight. Seeing structured output failures around tool-calls. ~2.3% of hits return malformed JSON (truncated array / trailing comma).

ricardo: any streaming vs batch split?

maya: Mostly microbatching + prefix-cache enabled. Streaming single-turn low incidence.

lila: Example payload from logs: 
```
assistant: {"tool": "charge", "params": [ {"id": 42, "amt": 100 },

...EOF
```
Parse error: unexpected EOF while reading array.

trey: Does the postprocess-hook add a trailing comma or tries to pretty-print?

maya: Postprocess just runs our soft-wrap that injects closing wrapper if missing. But here EOF happens before it runs because concat happens earlier.

ricardo: Could be tokenizer differences at int4 quant boundary -> model emits partial token that gets split across microbatch concat. Also our batch-join logic strips last byte when merging to avoid dup tokens. That could drop a closing bracket.

qa-bot: alert: canary/struct-integrity/heron-xt-int4 (2026-03-22) failure-rate=2.31% n=8700. Repro harness: `ci/canaries/heron_xt_json_repro.py`. Attached sample ids: [hxt-2561, hxt-2599, hxt-2610].

lila: Quick options: 1) bump parse retries to 2 and run `json-repair` fallback, 2) append sentinel token `
---JSON-END---
` to every generation before any concat, 3) disable microbatch-merging for canary. Which ship now?

trey: Fastest is parse-retry + json-repair. But that may hide root cause. Sentinel is easy too and safer.

maya: Let's do sentinel + keep thermostat gate off for int4 for now. Also flip microbatch-merging off for canary traffic only.

ricardo: I'll PR: - add sentinel in runtime generation (one-line), - add unit that simulates token-split across microbatch boundaries. Will run fuzz.

qa-bot: queued smoke: golden 400 from `schema-goldens/actions-v2.json` (id smoke-7765432100). ETA 20m.

deploy-bot: scheduling change: disable microbatch-merge for model:heron-xt-int4 in env:canary (change-id ch-20260322-11). Will roll in 2m.

lila: Also recording a probe: run with postprocess ON but microbatch OFF to see if postprocess causes issue independent of merging.

maya: Good call. Also collect raw token traces for failing samples (pre-merge / post-merge) and attach to ML-1142.

qa-bot: smoke done: 400 samples -> 0.75% failures (pre-change 2.31%). Report: `ci/canaries/results/7765432100/summary.html`. Token diffs uploaded to ML-1142.

ricardo: promising. Next: tighten merge logic (dont drop trailing partial token), add integration fuzz that splits tokens at random byte offsets, and add CI guard for regression >0.5%.

lila: Scheduling a 30m triage tomorrow to allocate fixes and owners.

maya: Thanks all. Keeping canary toggles in place until fixes land.
